transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all20 Poppler page images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0460-0479/page-0460.png through page-0479.png, scale1600. Read every left column then every right column. Classified all running titles, folios and printer signatures. Every indented continuation reconstructed as its own grouped verse. Exact raw PDF glyphs, bboxes, source IDs and legacy-font-v1 normalization preserved through source_evidence builder. No fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glossaries used as lexical aids only. Individually reinspected Semetey1960 glossary374/375 this batch; prior glossary1842 supports mighty-conqueror epithet. Primary Kyrgyz encyclopedia209–210 exact Baran enemy ethnonym and primary Kyrgyz Manas2010 parallels for milek and Korogoch read. No previous English poem translation used.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1548 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in order in ten consecutive blocks (nine blocks of160 and final108). All66 subsequent revised pairs reread against exact Kyrgyz, plus one final wording correction reread. Earlier lexical/alignment revisions included in full review. 9 whole unresolved verses remain separately excluded from English with complete fragments and reasons. Every repetition retained. Kanykei narrates the poisoning of Manas, his missing companions, Akayar rescuing him, her own battle and wounds, the medicine and long nursing, her responsibility for deaths, Kozkaman looting Talas, and Kyrgylchal finding Akayar then rebuking the companions at play. Source numbers, chronology tensions, violence, religious statements, epic medicine claims, source name variants and speaker shifts preserved without specialist certification.

alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1539 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF460–479 except20 watermarks.
